name: Bisai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Bisai city emblem in black: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved and horizontal strokes.
history: Flag of the former city of Bisai in Aichi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 June 1955.

features.role: Bisai city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved and horizontal strokes
